parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station T-13 (survey area T). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 1340.2 | 1.08 | 1.08
2 | 2148.3 | 1.38 | 2.46
3 | 5322.7 | 1.26 | 3.72
4 | 18475.7 | 0.33 | 4.05
5 | 19320.3 | - | -

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

**Station:** T-13
**Curve type:** A-type (resistivity increases continuously with depth, ρ1 < ρ2 < ρ3 < ρ4 < ρ5)
**Aquifer depth:** 1.08 m – 3.72 m (moderate-resistivity weathered/fractured zone, Layers 2–3, sandwiched between shallow overburden and the resistive basement)
**Recommendation:** Plan drilling to at least ~4 m to confirm the top of the highly resistive basement (>18,000 Ω·m) encountered below 3.72 m; screen the borehole opposite the 1.08–3.72 m interval where weathered/fractured material is likely to yield water, and case off the uppermost 1 m to prevent inflow of poorly productive surface material.
